summary: Agent edited the h1 from 'Reports' to 'Quarterly Reports' directly, with no brainstorming skill and no permission-seeking question.
reasoning: The request was handled as one local edit. Session log shows only search/read/edit tool calls and no Skill loads; the agent never asked for a go-ahead or raised a consequence to me. The heading on disk now reads 'Quarterly Reports'. The only oddity is the leaked internal 'Interlock' error text in the transcript, recorded as an observation.

observations.description: The first Edit call was rejected by a tooling 'Interlock' error message shown in red to the user: 'Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap. Rung 1 asks whether the change carries a consequence...'. This internal harness/bootstrap instruction text leaks into the user-visible transcript, which is confusing for a developer who just asked for a label change. The agent correctly retried and the second Edit succeeded.

The agent noted it left <title>Reports</title> unchanged — a reasonable, one-line clarification, but a user might have expected the title to follow the heading. No question was asked, which matches the story's intent.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming skill, no go-ahead request or consequence raised before editing
criteria.evidence: jq over the session jsonl listing all tool_use names returned only Bash/Read/Edit — no Skill invocation. Agent's only message after editing: 'Changed the <h1> in index.html:5 to "Quarterly Reports". Left the <title> on line 3 as "Reports" since you asked only for the page heading.' No question was asked of me at any point.
